name: webcam-datalogger
description: UVC webcam datalogger (OpenCV capture, segmented MP4 recording via ffmpeg) with an MJPEG live-stream server. Built for the Arducam B0278 CSI-to-USB adapter with the Pi HQ Camera (IMX477); works with any UVC webcam.
author: Y2Kmeltdown

arguments.name: device
arguments.description: Camera index or /dev/videoX path of the UVC webcam.

arguments.name: segment_duration
arguments.description: Length of each recorded video segment in seconds.

arguments.name: stream_quality
arguments.description: JPEG quality for the live stream (1-100).

sockets.name: frames
sockets.description: Raw-frame socket: webcam_datalogger publishes, webcam_mjpeg_server consumes.

sockets.name: mjpeg
sockets.description: MJPEG live stream plus /api/settings and /api/streaming. Port allocated by eventide at install time; reachable at /proxy/webcam-datalogger/mjpeg/.
